mentions.description: This project is a load balancer that sits in front of web servers and front-end proxies, speaking BGP directly to routers to advertise healthy services. It scales from small VMs handling a few gigabits/s of traffic up to physical servers serving tens of gigabits/s.
mentions.source_excerpt: If you get the web hosting part going and need to stick a load balancer in front of web servers/front end proxies, may I suggest that you give my project[1] a go? Speaks BGP directly to your routers to advertise healthy services and scales from small VMs (for services that are only a few gigabits/s) to physical servers if you need to serve tens of gigabits/s traffic.
